partners.title: ✨ Data Partners
partners.introduction: This project also provides data support for the following tools and websites:
partners.perlicaBot: A QQ bot and Arknights: Endfield game assistant.
partners.endfieldAtlas: An interactive map for Arknights: Endfield.
partners.cepPlanner: An all-in-one Arknights: Endfield toolkit for matrix planning and calculations, gear refinement planning, character guides, banner calendars, and more.
partners.endaxis: A combat rotation simulator for Arknights: Endfield.
partners.combatLogs: An Arknights: Endfield combat log and speedrun ranking website.
